before.requirement: After png_read_update_info, continue decoding accepted PNG row data through png_start_read_image and png_read_row.
before.reason: png_read_update_info initializes rows, so png_start_read_image takes its duplicate-call branch. png_app_error warns or raises a fatal error according to PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN; its initial value is missing.

after.requirement: After png_read_update_info, continue decoding accepted PNG row data through png_start_read_image and png_read_row.
after.reason: The same duplicate-call branch remains. The initial PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN value is still needed to determine whether the harness reaches png_read_row.

claims.reason: The old harness makes the same calls against unchanged initialization and duplicate-call contracts on both sides. The consequence cannot be timed until the flag's initial value is known.
missing_information: Initial PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN state and any read-structure initialization changes to it.
Provide png_create_png_struct in png.c and png_create_read_struct_2 in pngread.c to determine the initial PNG_FLAG_APP_ERRORS_WARN state.
